back_translation: Oh how the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger! He has hurled the glory of Israel from heaven down to earth, and has not remembered His footstool in the day of His anger.

The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without mercy. In His wrath He has torn down the fortresses of the Daughter of Judah. He has brought her kingdom and its princes down to the ground and defiled them.
In His fierce anger He has cut down every horn of Israel. He has drawn back His right hand when the enemy approached, and He has burned in Jacob like a blazing fire that devours all around.

He has bent His bow like an enemy; He has raised His right hand, set firm like a foe. He has slain all that was pleasing to the eye, and poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion.
The Lord has become like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds, and multiplied mourning and wailing for the Daughter of Judah.

He has torn down His tabernacle like a garden hut; He has destroyed His appointed meeting place. The LORD has made Zion forget appointed feast and Sabbath, and in His burning anger has spurned both king and priest.

The Lord has rejected His altar and abandoned His sanctuary. He has handed the walls of her palaces over to the enemy. They raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast.

The LORD purposed to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion. He stretched out the measuring line and did not withdraw His hand from destroying. He made rampart and wall lament; together they waste away.
Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations; the law is no more, and her prophets receive no vision from the LORD.

The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit silent on the ground. They have thrown dust on their heads and girded themselves with sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.

My eyes are worn out with tears; my inward parts are in turmoil; my liver is poured out on the ground because of the shattering of the daughter of my people, because children and nursing infants faint in the squares of the city.
They cry to their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the city squares, as their lives ebb away in their mothers' embrace.
O Daughter of Jerusalem, what can I say for you? To what shall I compare you? O Virgin Daughter of Zion, to what shall I liken you to comfort you? For your ruin is vast as the sea — who can heal you?
Your prophets saw for you visions empty and deceptive; they did not expose your iniquity to keep you from captivity. The oracles they gave you were empty and misleading.

All who pass along the way clap their hands at you in mockery. They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called perfect in beauty, the joy of all the earth?”
All your enemies open their mouths against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth, saying, “We have swallowed her! This is the day we waited for — we have lived to see it!”

The LORD has done what He purposed; He has fulfilled the word He commanded from days of old. He has overthrown without mercy; He has let the enemy rejoice over you and exalted the horn of your adversaries.
Their hearts cry out to the Lord. O wall of the Daughter of Zion, let tears stream down like a river day and night. Give yourself no rest; let your eyes have no respite.

Arise, cry out in the night, from the beginning of the first watch. Pour out your heart like water before the Lord. Lift up both your hands to Him for the lives of your little children, who faint from hunger at every street corner.
O LORD, look and consider: to whom have You done this? Should women eat the fruit of their womb, the infants they have nurtured? Should priest and prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
Young and old lie dead on the ground in the streets. My maidens and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of Your anger; You have slaughtered without mercy.
You summoned my terrors on every side as to a day of appointed feast. In the day of the LORD's anger no one escaped or survived. Those I nurtured and raised, my enemy has destroyed completely.
